name: William the Conqueror
short_desc: The Norman duke who conquered England in 1066 and established a new ruling dynasty.
date_note: Born about 1028; died on 9 September 1087. His reign in England is recorded separately.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.

periods.label: King of England
periods.date_note: King of England from 1066 until his death in 1087; his Norman dukedom began earlier.
